name: Image to Video
description: Wan 2.2 14B. Upload a picture and describe the motion. Makes a 5 second video, 640 x 640, 16 fps. Takes about 4 to 5 minutes.
promptGuide: Describe only the motion for about 5 seconds, in one or two short sentences: what moves, how it moves, and what the camera does (static, slow push in, pan left, ...). Do not describe the scene again; it comes from the start image. Keep to one simple action, with no scene cuts.
